name: Staff of Healing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Bard, Cleric, or Druid

last.text: vanishes in a flash of light

summary: 10 charges: Cure Wounds (1 per level, up to 4), Lesser Restoration (2), Mass Cure Wounds (5).
text: This staff has 10 charges. While holding it, you can cast one of the following spells from it, using your spellcasting ability modifier: Cure Wounds (1 charge per spell level, up to level 4), Lesser Restoration (2 charges) or Mass Cure Wounds (5 charges). The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff vanishes in a flash of light, lost forever.
